finalists.label: Sarcoidosis
finalists.why: It has the most decisive findings in the vignette, including nonregenerative normocytic normochromic anemia, osteolytic lesions, and granulomatous hepatitis.

finalists.label: Hypercalcemia of malignancy
finalists.why: It explains the hypercalcemia and weight loss, but is less specific than Sarcoidosis.

finalists.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
finalists.why: It explains the osteolytic lesions, but has less evidence than Sarcoidosis.
